movie.title: Daddy's in Trouble
movie.overview: Roberta is tired of taking care of the house and the kids all by herself, so she decides to take a vacation, leaving her husband to look after the children. The result is that the house is turned upside down as Fred tries to balance family demands with his work responsibilities. Amid laughter and chaos, the film shows how a family can overcome challenges when they stick together.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When an exhausted mother leaves on vacation, her husband is left to manage the household and children, sparking chaotic comedy as he struggles to balance work and family life.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Overwhelmed by the endless responsibilities of managing her home and children alone, Roberta decides it is time to take a well-deserved vacation. She leaves her husband, Fred, completely in charge of the house and the kids. Fred quickly finds himself in over his head as he attempts to juggle demanding work commitments with domestic duties. The resulting chaos eventually leads to heartwarming moments, proving that teamwork and family solidarity can overcome any mess.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Roberta is a mother who feels completely exhausted and neglected after carrying the sole burden of running the household and raising her children. Realizing she has reached her limit, she makes the bold decision to leave for a solo vacation, placing the full responsibility of domestic life on her husband, Fred. Confident in his ability to handle things, Fred steps up, but reality hits quickly as the daily demands of parenting prove far more complex than he anticipated. From chaotic mornings and cooking disasters to managing school schedules, the house is rapidly turned upside down. Fred finds himself constantly torn between critical work responsibilities and the urgent needs of his children, leading to comedic mishaps at every turn. As the disorder reaches its peak, Fred gains a profound newfound appreciation for everything his wife manages on a daily basis. With time running out before Roberta's return, Fred and the kids realize they must put aside their differences and work as a team to restore order. Through shared laughter, honest conversations, and mutual support, the family manages to clean up the mess and reconnect on a deeper level. In the end, Fred successfully balances his obligations, presenting a united family front that highlights the importance of partnership and togetherness.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Tired of taking care of her household and children completely on her own, Roberta takes a much-needed vacation, leaving her husband Fred in charge of the domestic front. Fred soon finds himself overwhelmed as he attempts to balance his career with the non-stop demands of parenting. As the house descends into utter chaos, the family must learn to pull together, creating a humorous and uplifting story about appreciation, teamwork, and family resilience.

story_structure.climax: The domestic disarray and competing work-family demands peak, forcing Fred and the children to confront the full extent of the turmoil and work together under pressure.
story_structure.conflict: Determined to give her family a wake-up call, Roberta goes on vacation, leaving Fred to handle the children, home maintenance, and his daily career demands on his own.
story_structure.resolution: Through the shared experience, Fred gains a deep appreciation for Roberta's daily efforts, and the family emerges closer and more collaborative as Roberta returns.
story_structure.introduction: Roberta is overwhelmed by the sole burden of managing the household and caring for their children, while her husband Fred focuses primarily on his work responsibilities.
story_structure.risingAction: Fred attempts to multitask, leading to mounting household chaos, hilarious mishaps, and growing difficulty balancing his professional obligations with family needs.
